entries.title: Updates, made easier.
entries.summary: The direct edition can now check for updates and install them from inside Trayage.

highlights.title: Check from wherever you work
highlights.description: Find Check for Updates in the Trayage menu, menu-bar popover, General settings, and About.

highlights.title: Daily checks, with your permission
highlights.description: Allow automatic checks while Trayage is running. See what changed and choose when to download and install a signed update.

highlights.title: Appearance follows your Mac
highlights.description: Switching from Light to Device appearance now follows your Mac’s setting and keeps billing controls readable.

highlights.title: A one-time step for earlier builds
highlights.description: If your current copy has no update checker, download this DMG, quit Trayage, and replace it in Applications. Keep your app data to retain settings and licensing.

entries.title: A little order for your Downloads.
entries.summary: The first version brings file review and confirmed cleanup together in a Mac app.

highlights.title: Review before you clear
highlights.description: Review files in a selected folder, choose what to remove, and confirm before unchanged files move to Trash. Trayage never empties the Trash.

highlights.title: Close at hand
highlights.description: Open Trayage from the menu bar and move into the full review window when you need a closer look.

highlights.title: File review stays on your Mac
highlights.description: Trayage scans and groups files locally. Purchases, licensing, and support use the services described in the privacy policy.

highlights.title: Made for both kinds of Mac
highlights.description: The signed and notarized direct download runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS 14 or later.
